title: secale cereale subsp. derzhavinii
intro: Secale cereale subsp. derzhavinii, commonly known as Derzhavin's rye, is a subspecies of rye (Secale cereale) that is native to Russia and Central Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. Derzhavin's rye is also rich in bioactive constituents, including antioxidants, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
